author: Navi (kimi)

chunks_reused.used_for: beat-driven breathing scale about the centre (the domain warp under everything).
chunks_reused.changed: Inlined. Centre-origin (`uv - 0.5`, scale, re-add 0.5) instead of the chunk's direct `uv *= ...`, so the zoom stays centred in the contained video rect rather than the canvas corner. Amplitude 0.16 (from 0.35, since it now rides on a real video that must stay recognisable).

chunks_reused.used_for: the filmic shoulder that keeps the pulse glow + superlinear bloom from flat-topping into white.
chunks_reused.changed: Unchanged in intent. I wrote it per-component as vec3(tanh(r),tanh(g),tanh(b)); that is valid but NOT required — GLSL ES 3.00 defines tanh(genType), so tanh(col) works on a vec3 directly. Per Vandor's correction 2026-09-13.

chunks_reused.used_for: the pre-shoulder crest bloom (`0.85` coefficient) that makes the light pulse *brighter and darker at once*.
chunks_reused.changed: Unchanged, placed BEFORE the tanh shoulder per the chunk's own note.

chunks_reused.used_for: the aspect-corrected, corner-normalised cubic vase around the stage.
chunks_reused.changed: Unchanged in math. Depth modulated by `0.45 * u_intensity` so the effect scales with the knob rather than always full-on.
Unchanged helper. Deliberately NOT keyed on `u_time`, so the dust is static per pixel (satisfies the no-crawl floor; flux modulates its amplitude, not its position).

chunks_deliberately_not_reused.reason: Its own note warns it SHIFTS HUE and destroys hue-bearing signal. The spec asks for a *perceptual* hue rotation, so I used a correct RGB->HSV->rotate->RGB (Iq rgb2hsv/hsv2rgb) instead of the swizzle.

built_new: Letterbox-to-contain (shader does its own black bars from u_res vs u_video_res), early-returning outside the contained rect.
Perceptual hue rotation (rgb2hsv -> fract(hue + deg/360) -> hsv2rgb), gated so 0 deg is a branch-free no-op.
Beat-driven chromatic aberration: R/B fringe scaled by `(1 +/- 0.004*u_pulse)`, one extra texture-fetch pair, constant (no crawl).
Band texture: `u_mid`/`u_high` as gentle baseline lifts, `u_flux` as faint static-dust amplitude.

uniforms_contract.u_bass: declared per the contract; consumed indirectly via page-computed u_pulse

notes: u_bass is declared but unused in the body: it is part of the mandated uniform contract and is folded into u_pulse by the page, so the declaration must stay (an unused uniform is legal and optimized out).

CORRECTION 2026-09-13 (Vandor, from the live run): a standalone GLSL ES .frag must put #version on the absolute first line — ANGLE on D3D11 rejects it after any leading byte. I originally shipped the //! header on line 1; the .frag is now fixed (#version line 1, //! header as a comment on line 2), so it compiles under ANY loader, not just the page's patched one.
Live result (Chrome 152 / RX 9070 XT / ANGLE-D3D11, HEVC hardware decode): compiled clean, empty info log, 0 dropped frames.

Compile-safe against GLSL ES 3.00: highp, no loops, no ?: on structs, no derivatives of discontinuous values. tanh is fine on a vec3 directly (genType overload exists); the per-component form is valid but unnecessary.
